verdict.rationale: Bento's own alerting docs say natural-language alert rules can route to a webhook destination, which is a first-party outbound HTTP callback for alert events. That evidence is a single marketing/FAQ line covering only alert firings, not a general event-subscription system. missing for 10: webhook registration/configuration docs, event type catalog beyond alerts, payload schema, signing/verification and retry semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
